primary_constraints.constraint: Kazakusan choices must not trigger Origin Stone.
Playing Frame Job against an Origin Stone owner must not trigger that weapon.
Origin Stone plus Sands of Time must not get stuck; Forbidden Sequence plus Arcane Flow hand-cap behavior was fixed. Exact sequencing needs independent traces.

source_findings.systems._resolve_choice: Has original options and selected object before dispatch. Snapshot unchosen payloads and equipped physical weapon identity before mutable choice resolution.
source_findings.systems._record_discover: Only records owner counters, no original options or source context. Cannot reconstruct unchosen cards from this later.
source_findings.discovery._defer_discover_followups: Existing innermost resolution-frame deferral provides continuation pattern; currently only physical selected-card discount listeners.
source_findings.generation._generation_choice: Deletes generation context after placement. Capture modifiers and origin beforehand where required.
source_findings.spell_casting: Internal casts are available; full automatic play also needs minion, location, weapon and hero handling with correct play-versus-summon semantics.

required_cases: selected card burns in full hand
nested Discover while Origin Stone resolves
final durability charge and replacement weapon
Secret identity hidden in opponent history
Trust Fall multi-choice no duplicate play
random targeting and no valid target
automatic choice policy and physical card modifiers
Quest completion at eight, not historical seven

shared_automatic_play_workstream.existing: Physical internal spell casting supports random targets, suspended choices, spell modifiers and replay frames. No generic all-card automatic-play entry point was found in expanded engine.
consumers: JAIL_500 replay cards and end turn
requirements: Use one resumable frame per physical card; preserve parent sequence through nested choices.
Preflight card type and complete effect support before irreversible removal or RNG use.
Spell branch reuses physical internal caster and its privacy rules.
Define separate minion entry and Battlecry semantics from summon-only behavior using evidence.
Handle board capacity, locations, weapons and hero replacement explicitly.
Do not temporarily add a card to hand and fake a paid play: that would alter costs, Outcast, Combo, Quest counts and provenance.
Snapshot Origin Stone physical weapon identity so nested replacement cannot consume the wrong durability.
Keep effect-attributed casts distinct from player-paid plays.
